item.title: OV SULFUR Celebrate Release of “Endless” Album with Vocal Playthrough Video for ‘Forlorn’
item.description: On January 16th, blackened deathcore quintet Ov Sulfur released their sophomore album, Endless, via Century Media Records. Propelled by the vocalizations of frontman Ricky Hoover, Ov Sulfur pushes the boundaries of their deathcore origins on this record, simultaneously embracing black metal while exploring a surprising degree of melody that never dilutes their genre-decimating approach.
